decision_rule.boundary_rule: If a selected value is on an explored boundary, expand that boundary and rerun before accepting it.
decision_rule.tie_break: Prefer lower runtime/resource/complexity cost only after quality metrics are indistinguishable under the available evidence.

MEM-SCORE-001.title: Memory cue scoring and direct-evidence admission
hard_invariants: unknown evidence must never be fabricated
canonical event provenance remains intact
guarded associations never activate without their required cue semantics
MEM-SCORE-001.search: Coarse full-domain sweep followed by refinement of the non-dominated region; weights are jointly searched on the unit simplex. Boundary winners force expansion/refinement.
MEM-SCORE-001.holdout: Generated adversarial life histories and frozen corpora not used to choose the exploratory winner.

MEM-BREADTH-001.title: Memory packet, candidate, active-state, and context breadth
hard_invariants: required evidence is not truncated in any passing scenario
unknown-fact abstention does not regress
candidate generation stays deterministic
MEM-BREADTH-001.search: Geometric expansion below/above current integer bounds plus local refinement. Continue expanding while quality improves or the winner is at an explored boundary.

MEM-GRAPH-001.title: Associative traversal depth, decay, and graph breadth
hard_invariants: required cue terms on guarded edges are respected
association routing never rewrites canonical evidence
unknown-fact abstention does not regress
MEM-GRAPH-001.search: Joint integer/continuous sweep because hop depth, decay, and graph breadth interact. Refine decay around non-dominated candidates and expand graph limits when boundary-selected.

CAP-DISCOVERY-001.title: Deterministic capability discovery scoring and result breadth
hard_invariants: discovery remains deterministic
excluded capabilities never appear
kind filtering is exact
no zero-score capability is returned
CAP-DISCOVERY-001.search: Joint discrete/continuous sweep over scoring coefficients and breadth. Preserve ordering only when supported by relevance or prefer the simpler zero-parameter rule if quality is equivalent.

CAP-LOOP-001.title: Stateless capability selection breadth and recurrent round budget
hard_invariants: router cannot invoke a capability outside the supplied catalog
dependencies and execution order remain application-owned
a user response requires explicit RESPOND
CAP-LOOP-001.search: Scripted router provides exhaustive deterministic coverage; real Ollama confirms the smallest non-binding bound. Integer bounds expand when a correct workload is truncated at the boundary.

SCHED-SERVICE-001.title: Attention service guarantees and priority representation
hard_invariants: deterministic ordering for identical state
dependencies are never bypassed
atomic interruption semantics are preserved
no eligible service class starves indefinitely under a feasible workload
SCHED-SERVICE-001.search: Discrete workload simulation across service-guarantee vectors. Use Pareto frontier rather than a weighted latency score.

RES-NATIVE-001.title: Native host resource admission and process-estimate calibration
hard_invariants: no benchmark candidate may crash or exhaust the host
probe failure remains fail-closed
committed reservations are never invalidated
system headroom remains positive under admitted load
RES-NATIVE-001.search: Collect real peak/pressure distributions first; derive candidate margins from observed distributions, then replay/load-test them. Do not infer these values from GitHub CI.

OLLAMA-RUNTIME-001.title: Ollama residency observation and warm/cold admission calibration
hard_invariants: probe failure remains fail-closed
only the configured model can satisfy residency
warm credit never exceeds the cold-load reservation difference
claim-time residency changes cannot weaken admission safety
OLLAMA-RUNTIME-001.search: Measure /api/ps latency and resident-memory observations on the target host, then exercise warm/cold transition cases. Keep the probe timeout above observed healthy tails while preserving prompt failure on an unavailable runtime.

WORKER-NATIVE-001.title: Worker leases, launch retries, retry delay, and process timeouts
hard_invariants: at-most-once effects remain protected
no live valid worker is falsely replaced in a passing safety candidate
hung/abandoned work is eventually recoverable
WORKER-NATIVE-001.search: Fault-injection distributions plus native duration samples. Lease and timeout candidates are derived from observed tails; retry schedules are tested against measured resource-pressure durations.

LLM-NATIVE-001.title: Local-model HTTP timeout, output token caps, and schema retry budget
hard_invariants: valid required output is not truncated
invalid structured output never crosses the schema boundary
timeout failure remains explicit
LLM-NATIVE-001.search: Pilot samples estimate latency/output-length distributions. Candidate bounds are generated from observed tails and tested under cold/warm/contention conditions; sample size is increased when competing settings cannot be distinguished.

ID-COLLISION-001.title: Truncated deterministic identifier collision risk
hard_invariants: collision probability at supported scale stays below the documented risk budget
ID-COLLISION-001.search: Calculate the birthday bound over supported object counts, then verify generated large corpora. This is a risk proof, not a retrieval-quality benchmark.
